name: Waka-sama no Zasuru Sekai
source: Umezono Ryouga inherits his late grandfather's Shinto shrine, having nowhere else to go and no relatives left alive to stay with. There, he accidentally summons and unseals a goddess which nearly eats him alive. Fortunately, he is able to get out of it by offering to cook and buy said goddess Waka-sama all the delicious food that the little money he earns from his part-time job can buy. Brimming with curiousity, Waka-sama ventures out into modern Japan with Ryouga, looking for her sister and discovering new foods, sights, spirits, monsters, and gods all the while.
translation:
梅园辽河继承已故祖父的神社，无处可去，也没有活着的亲人可以投靠。在那里，他意外召唤并解封了一名差点把他活吞的女神。幸运的是，他提出为这位女神和香大人烹饪并购买兼职收入能买到的所有美食，终于脱离险境。

充满好奇的和香大人与辽河一起走进现代日本，寻找自己的妹妹，同时不断发现新的食物、景色、精灵、怪物与神明。
